sections.content: To say where someone is going, use 'Hová megy?' (Where is he/she going?) and respond with a destination using -ba/-be (to/into).

items.spanish: Megyünk az iskolába. András jön velünk.
items.english: We go to school. András comes with us.

sections.content: Destination requires -ba/-be (to): iskolába. Location requires -ban/-ben (in/at): iskolában. Notice the vowel harmony: back-vowel words get -ba/-ban, front-vowel words get -be/-ben.
